manual.homelink_storage.title: User manual
manual.homelink_storage.start.title: Getting started
manual.homelink_storage.start.body:
# Four blocks
The **Controller** manages the network and mounts on any block face. Its indicator blinks while inventories are connected. A **Link** discovers inventories in its chunk. A **Repeater** extends coverage to neighbouring chunks. The **Terminal** is the only block that shows items and withdraws them. The **Controller** screen manages the network: names, zones, offline inventories and refresh. Links and Repeaters have no screen: right-click shows their state (binding, inventories covered) and draws their coverage zone, their whole chunk, for 30 s, with the zones of the other nodes of the network; a second click hides it (copper: clicked block, green: active, red: offline). The **Deposit** screen only shows its own 27 input slots, never the network. An object that no chest holds yet goes, after 5 s, to an **Overflow Chest** of the network; without free space it waits in the Deposit and the Terminal shows it (“⚠ waiting” badge, “Waiting (Deposit)” filter), where it can be taken back.

# Withdraw items
Click an item in the grid: **double-click** or **Shift+click** takes a stack, **right-click** half a stack, **Ctrl+click** one item and **middle-click** fills your inventory. The Quantity field and **Take** withdraw any amount. The server pulls real items from every inventory holding them, starting with the selected one. If several variants are grouped, choose the exact variant first. With JEI, the **+** button of a recipe fetches its missing ingredients. HomeCore CONTROL permission is required.

# Double chests
All 54 slots are accessible across chunk borders when both halves are loaded. An unloaded half makes the entire double chest unavailable; chunks are never force-loaded.

# Wall terminal
Place the Terminal against a block's side for a wall screen. On top of a block, it keeps its stand. It can also mount on a ceiling. Binding and operation remain the same.

USB key: right-click the controller to remember it, then each link, terminal or repeater to bind it. Configuration permission is still required. A lit indicator means an active connection. An isolated repeater stays dark.
manual.homelink_storage.connect.title: Chunks and repeaters
manual.homelink_storage.connect.body:
# Select the Controller
With an empty hand, sneak-right-click the **Controller**. Then sneak-right-click a Link, Repeater or Terminal to bind it. Server permissions are checked for every change.

# Cover one chunk
A bound **Link** discovers every compatible block inventory in its loaded chunk, at any height. More Links in the same chunk do not duplicate items.

# Reach another chunk
Place a **Repeater** in a chunk directly north, south, east or west of a covered chunk, then bind it. Each connected Repeater covers its own chunk. Diagonal Repeaters do not connect; a chain without an active Link stays offline.

# Loaded chunks only
Storage never forces a chunk to load. Unloading a Link or a Repeater interrupts dependent chunks until the chain is loaded again.
manual.homelink_storage.search.title: Search and locate
manual.homelink_storage.search.body:
# Search the index
Search by translated item name, registry ID such as **minecraft:diamond**, namespace, or a tag prefixed with **#**. Sorting and filtering use the synchronized client cache.

# Item variants
Grouped view combines the same registry item. Variants view keeps different data components separate, including enchantments, potions and configured modded items.

# Locations
Select an item to see every inventory containing it, with quantity, zone, coordinates and distance. **Locate** displays a private temporary marker after server validation.

# Organize
Open the Controller to name the network and its inventories, create zones, assign them and forget offline inventories. The Terminal only finds and takes items. An offline inventory can be forgotten; an online inventory remains automatically discovered.
manual.homelink_storage.monitor.title: Monitoring
manual.homelink_storage.monitor.body:
# Capacity
Capacity is based on occupied slots. The Controller comparator outputs 0 to 15 from the same value.

# HomeCore
The Controller is a real HomeCore device. It exposes capacity, item count, unique items, inventory count and full inventories. Warning, full, offline and online transitions publish bounded events.

# Efficient updates
Known changes are queued and the server performs staggered consistency checks. Searches never rescan all inventories for each typed character.

# Access
VIEW allows browsing and locating, CONTROL allows refreshing and withdrawals, and CONFIGURE allows names, zones and binding. The server remains authoritative.
manual.homelink_storage.trouble.title: Troubleshooting
manual.homelink_storage.trouble.body:
# No inventory appears
Check that the Link is bound and in the same chunk as the inventories. Wait for the periodic discovery or press **Refresh**. Only loaded block inventories exposing the standard NeoForge item capability are detected.

# A Repeater is offline
Every step must be in a cardinally adjacent chunk and lead back to a loaded Link. Diagonal placement, an unloaded middle chunk or a broken node interrupts the branch.

# Access denied
Use the Controller owner or a player with the required HomeCore permission. The client cannot bypass network membership or distance checks.

# Missing totals
An unloaded chunk is removed from current totals and kept as unavailable until it returns. Storage does not load it automatically. Limits are configurable in the world server configuration.

# Locate fails
The target inventory must still exist, remain covered and be loaded. Reopen or refresh the Terminal after repairing the coverage chain.
